verdict.rationale: Clerk documents session lifecycle management with active device monitoring and session revocation, and its user profile UI shows a per-device "Sign out of device" action, so the user-side view-and-revoke-individually flow is covered. The pack has no evidence of an admin-facing view of a user's sessions or devices, or of a bulk "revoke all sessions" action. Missing for 10: admin-side session/device visibility and revocation, sign-out-all/bulk revocation, in-depth docs or API references for session revocation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
